color.fp-primary: Key brand colour: filled `fp-button`, text buttons, the selected day in `FlightDatePickerDialog`, icons in `EmptyState`/`ErrorState`. As text it holds 4.5:1 on `fp-surface`, `fp-background` and every surface container in every theme. Cockpit turns it amber, Chart navy.
color.fp-on-primary: Text and icons on `fp-primary` fills (`fp-button` label, selected date); also the thumb of an 'on' switch.
color.fp-primary-container: Tonal primary fill: the route-detail hero band, the FAB and the contained `MorphingLoadingIndicator`.
color.fp-on-primary-container: Text and icons on `fp-primary-container` (hero, FAB, contained loader).
color.fp-inverse-primary: Primary accent on `fp-inverse-surface` (5:1 or more in every theme); Material role carried from the Kotlin scheme, no mirror component paints it yet.
color.fp-secondary: Secondary accent role from the Kotlin scheme; no mirror component paints it directly. Use `fp-secondary-container` for selection instead.
color.fp-on-secondary: Text on `fp-secondary` fills; carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-secondary-container: Selection fill: the active `NavigationBar`/`NavigationRail` indicator, `fp-button--tonal`, a selected `FilterField` and the selected `ModeSelector` chip.
color.fp-on-secondary-container: Text and icons on `fp-secondary-container` (active nav item, tonal button, selected chip or filter).
color.fp-tertiary: Warning accent: the 'warn' result on `StartupCheckScreen`. Amber in the brand themes, sky blue in Cockpit. Holds 4.5:1 on surfaces except `fp-surface-dim` in Chart (4.39:1).
color.fp-on-tertiary: Text on `fp-tertiary` fills; carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-tertiary-container: Tonal tertiary fill; carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-on-tertiary-container: Text on `fp-tertiary-container`; carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-background: The window behind everything: `FlightPlannerTheme fullBleed`, `PhoneFrame`, `TabletFrame`. Same value as `fp-surface`.
color.fp-on-background: Default text on `fp-background` (frames, the status-bar clock, screen headlines).
color.fp-surface: Base surface: the `fp-surface` class and the sticky `MonthHeader` in the logbook.
color.fp-on-surface: Primary text and icons on every surface and surface container: app bar titles, card titles, figures, the active nav label. 8.9:1 or more on all of them in every theme.
color.fp-surface-variant: Variant surface role carried from the Kotlin scheme; the mirror paints surface containers instead.
color.fp-on-surface-variant: Secondary text and icons: the inactive nav bar, app-bar back and action icons, field labels, captions under figures, the sheet drag handle. 6:1 or more on every surface and container in every theme.
color.fp-surface-tint: Elevation tint role, equal to `fp-primary`; carried from the Kotlin scheme, the mirror does not tint surfaces.
color.fp-inverse-surface: Inverse ground (snackbar-style surfaces); carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-inverse-on-surface: Text on `fp-inverse-surface`; carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-error: Failure: the border and label of a failing `TextField`, its supporting text, and the `ErrorState` title. 4.5:1 on surfaces except `fp-surface-container-highest` (4.41:1) and `fp-surface-dim` (4.08:1) in Chart.
color.fp-on-error: Text on `fp-error` fills; carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-error-container: Tonal error fill; carried Material role, unused by the mirror (`SwipeActionBackground` and `ErrorState` do not paint it).
color.fp-on-error-container: Text on `fp-error-container`; carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-outline: Borders that carry meaning: the `TextField` box, an unselected `ModeSelector` chip, the switch track and its off thumb. 3.7:1 or more on `fp-surface` and `fp-surface-container-low`.
color.fp-outline-variant: Hairlines that only separate: the glass plate edge on the globe, a filled field's border, `FilterField`, the date-picker headline rule, the METAR raw-report rule. Below 3:1 by design; never the only mark of a control.
color.fp-scrim: The dimmed layer under a modal: `ScrimOverlay`'s dim layer.
color.fp-surface-bright: Brightest surface role from the Kotlin scheme; unused by the mirror.
color.fp-surface-dim: Dimmest surface role from the Kotlin scheme; unused by the mirror.
color.fp-surface-container: Default card ground: `fp-card`, `RouteCard`, the `NavigationBar`, `ChallengeWidgetCard`, and at 0.82 alpha the globe's glass plates and glass app bar.
color.fp-surface-container-high: Raised ground: `ConfirmationDialog`, the icon disc in `EmptyState`/`ErrorState`, widget figures, a hovered picker result.
color.fp-surface-container-highest: Highest ground: the switch track and a hovered date in the picker.
color.fp-surface-container-low: Low ground: `BottomSheet`, `MetarPanel`, `VisitedNetworkCard`, and the notch behind a `TextField` label.
color.fp-surface-container-lowest: Lowest container role from the Kotlin scheme; unused by the mirror.
color.fp-primary-fixed: Fixed primary fill (the same in light and dark); carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-primary-fixed-dim: Dimmer fixed primary fill; carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-on-primary-fixed: Text on `fp-primary-fixed` and `fp-primary-fixed-dim`; carried Material role, unused.
color.fp-on-primary-fixed-variant: Lower-emphasis text on `fp-primary-fixed`; carried Material role, unused.
color.fp-secondary-fixed: Fixed secondary fill; carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-secondary-fixed-dim: Dimmer fixed secondary fill; carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-on-secondary-fixed: Text on `fp-secondary-fixed` and `fp-secondary-fixed-dim`; carried Material role, unused.
color.fp-on-secondary-fixed-variant: Lower-emphasis text on `fp-secondary-fixed`; carried Material role, unused.
color.fp-tertiary-fixed: Fixed tertiary fill; carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-tertiary-fixed-dim: Dimmer fixed tertiary fill (brand amber); carried Material role, unused by the mirror.
color.fp-on-tertiary-fixed: Text on `fp-tertiary-fixed` and `fp-tertiary-fixed-dim`; carried Material role, unused.
color.fp-on-tertiary-fixed-variant: Lower-emphasis text on `fp-tertiary-fixed`; carried Material role, unused.
color.fp-sky-day-low: `SkyProfile` daytime sky at the horizon (bottom stop of the sky gradient). Scenery, not a text ground.
color.fp-sky-day-high: `SkyProfile` daytime sky aloft (top stop); also the ocean behind `GlobeView`'s sphere.
color.fp-sky-ground-subsurface: `SkyProfile` ground below the surface line; carried from the Kotlin scenery set, not referenced by the mirror bundle.
color.fp-sky-ground-fog: `SkyProfile` fog lying on the field; carried scenery colour, not referenced by the mirror bundle.
color.fp-sky-ground-dry: `SkyProfile` ground strip for a dry field (the one surface state the mirror draws).
color.fp-sky-ground-wet: `SkyProfile` ground for a wet field; carried scenery colour, not referenced by the mirror bundle.
color.fp-sky-ground-snow: `SkyProfile` ground under snow; carried scenery colour, not referenced by the mirror bundle.
color.fp-sky-ground-frost: `SkyProfile` ground under frost; carried scenery colour, not referenced by the mirror bundle.
color.fp-sky-ground-icy: `SkyProfile` ground for an icy field; carried scenery colour, not referenced by the mirror bundle.
color.fp-sky-day-cloud-edge: `SkyProfile` outline of a cloud deck by day.
color.fp-sky-twilight-cloud-edge: `SkyProfile` outline of a cloud deck at twilight.
color.fp-sky-night-cloud-edge: `SkyProfile` outline of a cloud deck at night.
color.fp-sky-celestial-sun: `SkyProfile` sun disc. Never drawn over an IFR field: the category follows from the sky.
color.fp-sky-celestial-moon-dark: `SkyProfile` shadowed face of the moon; carried scenery colour, not referenced by the mirror bundle.
color.fp-sky-sock-band: Windsock orange: the sock's bands, and in `RunwayDiagram` the favoured runway's wind ray and ident. 3.2:1 or more on `fp-surface` and `fp-surface-container`, so use it for marks and bold idents, not body text.
color.fp-vfr-container: VFR chip fill in `FlightRulesBadge`. Standard chart green; never re-themed, never used for anything but a flight category.
color.fp-vfr-on-container: VFR letters on `fp-vfr-container` (6.5:1 or more in every theme).
color.fp-mvfr-container: MVFR chip fill in `FlightRulesBadge`. Standard chart blue; never re-themed or reused.
color.fp-mvfr-on-container: MVFR letters on `fp-mvfr-container` (6.4:1 or more in every theme).
color.fp-ifr-container: IFR chip fill in `FlightRulesBadge`. Standard chart red; never re-themed or reused.
color.fp-ifr-on-container: IFR letters on `fp-ifr-container` (6.2:1 or more in every theme).
color.fp-lifr-container: LIFR chip fill in `FlightRulesBadge`. Standard chart magenta; never re-themed or reused.
color.fp-lifr-on-container: LIFR letters on `fp-lifr-container` (5.6:1 or more in every theme).
color.fp-unknown-container: Chip fill when a station has no category (`rules="UNKNOWN"`) in `FlightRulesBadge`.
color.fp-unknown-on-container: Letters on `fp-unknown-container` (5.7:1 or more in every theme).
color.background: Alias of `fp-background`, under the plain name this page paints a preview's ground from. Nothing in the app or the mirror reads it; use `fp-background`.

radius.fp-shape-extra-small: 4px corner: the globe's glass plates and glass app-bar buttons, the `TextField` box.
radius.fp-shape-large: 16px corner: `MetarPanel`, `SkeletonCard`, list rows and the FAB on screens.
radius.fp-shape-large-increased: 20px corner: cards. `RouteCard`, `fp-card`, `SwipeActionBackground`, the immersive globe's figure plate.
radius.fp-shape-extra-large: 28px corner: `BottomSheet` (top corners only), `ConfirmationDialog`, `FlightDatePickerDialog`, the `EmptyState`/`ErrorState` icon disc, the outline hero on screens.
radius.fp-shape-extra-large-increased: 32px corner from the Expressive scale; no mirror component uses it.
radius.fp-shape-extra-extra-large: 48px corner, the top of the Expressive scale; no mirror component uses it.

motion.fp-motion-spatial-duration: Default spatial spring (451ms): anything that moves or resizes, e.g. `RouteCard` entering or replacing. Pair with `--fp-motion-spatial-easing` from bundle.css.
motion.fp-motion-spatial-fast-duration: Fast spatial spring (376ms): the swipe-action icon and the switch thumb.
motion.fp-motion-spatial-slow-duration: Slow spatial spring (616ms) for large moves; no mirror component uses it yet.
motion.fp-motion-effects-duration: Default effects spring (247ms): fades, colour and elevation, e.g. the nav indicator and `FilterField` selection. Never overshoots.
motion.fp-motion-effects-fast-duration: Fast effects spring (166ms): date-picker day and pressable card feedback.
motion.fp-motion-effects-slow-duration: Slow effects spring (343ms); no mirror component uses it yet.
motion.fp-stagger: 30ms per row for a list entrance (`RouteCard enterIndex`), capped at eight rows; off under prefers-reduced-motion.

display-large.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-display-large`; in markup use that class, which also sets tabular figures. Largest figure slot; no mirror component sets it.

display-medium.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-display-medium`; in markup use that class, which also sets tabular figures. Display figure slot; no mirror component sets it.

display-small.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-display-small`; in markup use that class, which also sets tabular figures. Display figure slot; no mirror component sets it.

headline-large.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-headline-large`; in markup use that class, which also sets tabular figures. The statistics headline figure: total distance in `HeroDistanceCard`.

headline-medium.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-headline-medium`; in markup use that class, which also sets tabular figures. Screen titles: Plan, Fleet, Logbook in the list screens.

headline-small.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-headline-small`; in markup use that class, which also sets tabular figures. Detail titles: the airframe name in `FleetDetailPane`, the leg in `FlightDetailPane`.

title-large.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-title-large`; in markup use that class, which also sets tabular figures. Secondary figures: `MetricGrid` and `StatSummaryStrip` values, the route plate on the immersive globe.

title-medium.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-title-medium`; in markup use that class, which also sets tabular figures. List-row titles: the airframe or leg in fleet and logbook rows.

title-small.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-title-small`; in markup use that class, which also sets tabular figures. The aircraft name on `RouteCard`, the month in the date picker, compact row titles.

body-large.sample: Pick an aircraft and generate a few.
body-large.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-body-large`; in markup use that class, which also sets proportional figures. A typed `TextField` value (the field itself sets it tabular and left to right) and large row titles. Otherwise keep figures out of body.

body-medium.sample: Pick an aircraft and generate a few.
body-medium.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-body-medium`; in markup use that class, which also sets proportional figures. Supporting copy: dialog and empty- or error-state messages, the METAR sky line, a pane's category or date line.

body-small.sample: Pick an aircraft and generate a few.
body-small.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-body-small`; in markup use that class, which also sets proportional figures. Small row details, and the raw METAR set in the mono family.

label-large.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-label-large`; in markup use that class, which also sets tabular figures. Button labels (`fp-button`) and row figures.

label-medium.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-label-medium`; in markup use that class, which also sets tabular figures. Navigation labels on `NavigationBar` and `NavigationRail`.

label-small.usage: Mirrors `fp-type-label-small`; in markup use that class, which also sets tabular figures. The smallest labels: field and filter labels, `RouteCard` category, date-picker weekdays, row details, stat eyebrows such as TOTAL DISTANCE.
